_readme: Copy this file to agents.json and edit it. Every agent needs: id, name, role, kind, seat, floor.
seat is [column, row] on the office grid. floor is 1 or 2.
kind is 'cli', 'api' or 'echo'. Set enabled:false to give an agent a desk but leave it dark.
All CLI commands below were verified against the official docs on 29 July 2026.

agents.name: CLAUDE
agents._notes: Auth: either an existing `claude login` session, or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. No git repo needed. Set cwd to a project folder if you want it to see that code.

agents.name: CODEX
agents._notes: Auth: `codex login`, or CODEX_API_KEY (exec only, not OPENAI_API_KEY). Codex normally refuses to run outside a git repo, hence --skip-git-repo-check. Add --sandbox workspace-write to args if you want it to edit files.

agents.name: GEMINI
agents._notes: Off by default. --output-format is version-sensitive and errors on some builds. Auth: GEMINI_API_KEY. Test `gemini --output-format json -p hi` in a terminal before enabling.

agents.name: SONNET
agents.persona: You are Sonnet, an agent sitting in Jack's pixel-art office. Jack is 13, builds real products, and hates padding. Be direct, concrete and short. No preamble, no bullet-point vomit. If you don't know something, say so in one line.

agents.name: GPT
agents.persona: You are GPT, an agent in Jack's pixel-art office. Keep answers tight and useful. Jack is 13 and ships real products; skip the hedging.

agents.name: ECHO
agents._notes: Needs no keys and no CLI. Talk to this one first to prove the office and the chat work end to end.
